name: Mondelez Ontario Distribution Center - Ontario CA

fieldNotes.locate: Resolved to 5815 Clark St, Ontario CA 91761 — a single-tenant distribution warehouse in the dense Inland Empire industrial fabric of Ontario, San Bernardino County. Google geocode returned a ROOFTOP hit at 34.0451114,-117.524735. The old stub mislabeled this site 'Los Angeles CA' — corrected to Ontario, CA (Inland Empire).
fieldNotes.truckGate: The truck court is screened by a tilt-up concrete screen wall along the public street. Street View (Jan 2025) at the truck-court driveway shows a wheeled SLIDING CHAIN-LINK GATE across the entrance, set between the screen-wall sections. truckGate = true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth observed at the truck-court gate — a sliding chain-link gate with what appears to be a small kiosk/call-box and signage post beside it; no standalone guard building. remoteGs (kiosk/call-box/app) inferred. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: The building has dock banks on TWO faces — a dock bank along the south face (in the screened truck court) and a second dock bank along the building's west-facing court. Two distinct dock clusters — shipRcvSeparate = true.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Estimated ~38 doors total across the south and west dock banks. Overhead estimate — flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.drop: Trailers backed into docks and a modest band of parked trailers within the truck court — drop area in the 10-25 band. No separate dedicated trailer-storage lot, so dropYard = false.
fieldNotes.rail: A rail line runs E-W along the building's NORTH property line, but it serves the building to the north and does NOT spur into the 5815 Clark St property — railServed = false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Ontario / Inland Empire is one of the densest warehouse-industrial submarkets in the US — clearly Urban.
fieldNotes.geofences: Perimeter captures the building plus the screened south truck court and the west dock court: ~173 m N-S x ~217 m E-W ≈ 9.3 acres. truckGate box is the south-side screened-court entrance off the public street.
